    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    parents = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

    colors = [0] * (n + 1)
    max_color = 0
    result = []

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        parent = parents[i - 1]
        used_colors = set()

        # Collect colors of all children of the parent
        for child in children[parent]:
            if colors[child] != 0:
                used_colors.add(colors[child])

        # Assign the smallest unused color
        color = 1
        while color in used_colors:
            color += 1

        colors[i] = color
        max_color = max(max_color, color)
        result.append(max_color)

        # Add the new node to the children of its parent
        children[parent].append(i)

    print(" ".join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    children = defaultdict(list)
    main()
